description: A zero-exit Herdr reply that is non-JSON (or JSON lacking `result`) is a protocol error (runner.run's docstring: 'cannot mistake it for an empty listing'), and `workers` is one of the commands that fails open to it rather than crashing: every live count renders `?` and the exit code stays 0 ('an unreachable Herdr prints ? and still exits 0', cmd_workers's own docstring) — this is the malformed-reply slice of spec-tests-harness.md item 10's protocol matrix; a hung/timeout Herdr reply and the richer dispatch-path closed-error cases that item also names need a stateful fake Herdr this harness does not have.

home.config_toml:
[accounts.seat-b]
kind = "codex"
short = "sb"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home}}"
pool = "codex:b"

[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"

[projects.sandbox.chains]
explorer = ["seat-b"]

[roles.explorer]
write_scope = "none"
effort = "low"
on_exhausted = "degrade"
skills = []

[roles.explorer.models]
codex = "gpt-test"

expect.stdout:
workers ?/3
seats: seat-b ?
projects: sandbox ? open, ceiling 3
orchestrators ? (excluded from workers; they do not count against max_concurrent)
